invariants.expression: result == (super.touchDown(event, x, y, pointer, button) && ((pointer != 0 || button == 0) && !disabled))
invariants.rationale: This expresses the return value logic combining all early returns according to the observed method body.
If superclass touchDown is false, or pointer/button check fails, result will be false.
If pointer != 0, will not short-circuit second check and result can only be true if all prior conditions passed.
If not disabled, flow is only possible if result is true due to the return true at the end.

invariants.expression: result || super.touchDown(event, x, y, pointer, button) == false || ((pointer == 0 && button != 0) || disabled)
invariants.rationale: If result is false, at least one early exit was taken.
